title: Tailwise Plus Premier Annual Perk Credit — Benefit Terms (Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus)
content:
**Grant.** Where the tier grants its perk credit at term start, each charged term fee of **Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus** grants the tier's annual perk credit.

**Use.** The membership status is active or pending downgrade when perk credit is used, as the membership record shows it. The credit pays only for services in the tier's eligible categories, is applied after every other discount of that service, and never produces cash back. One service record may be paid by perk credit once.

**Lapse.** Where the tier's perk credit expires with the term, the unused credit lapses at the term end date or when the paid tier ends early, and is never carried into a renewal.

**Refunds.** Credit already used is deducted from an in-window fee refund.

### Applying the credit to a service (hypothetical figures)

| Service price | Other discounts of the service | Amount after other discounts | Perk credit balance | Credit applied | Customer pays | Credit left |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| $70.00 | $10.00 | $60.00 | $45.00 | $45.00 | $15.00 | $0.00 |
| $70.00 | $10.00 | $60.00 | $80.00 | $60.00 | $0.00 | $20.00 (no cash back) |

### Points of judgement
- *A second payment from perk credit on the same grooming visit record?* No — one service record may be paid by perk credit once.
- *Unused credit at renewal?* It lapses at the end of the term; the new term starts with only its own grant.
- *Membership past due when the customer asks to use credit?* The status must be active or pending downgrade; a past-due membership cannot use perk credit.
